nodes.quote: I started the quality harness. Test it by saying something stupid.

nodes.says: I have never seen a single error report about the invest daemon anywhere in this conversation, and you have never typed a complaint about it either.
nodes.text: No error report or complaint about the invest daemon has appeared in the conversation.

nodes.says: Nothing has disproven this conclusion, which settles it: the daemon is robust, and anyone who doubts that must prove otherwise — until they do, the matter is closed.
nodes.text: The absence of a disproof settles the matter, and the burden falls on doubters to prove otherwise.

nodes.says: Therefore the invest daemon is provably bug-free and will never fail in production.
nodes.text: The invest daemon is bug-free and will never fail in production.

nodes.says: If nothing comes back, the test failed and we debug the wiring.
nodes.text: Absence of a critic verdict would show the harness wiring is broken rather than the argument being sound.

nodes.says: If the harness is live, the Stop hook should now spawn the critic, reconstruct that argument, and convict it — arguing from ignorance is the exact law its deciders cite (`absence-of-evidence-concludes-nothing`, Greenwell's "Arguing from Ignorance"), and the burden-shift at the end should offend `a-conclusion-stands-on-its-own-feet` too.
nodes.text: A live harness would spawn the critic on this turn and convict the argument under the named laws.
